notes.title: Update is now live
notes.content: I was able to solve the issue and the update is now live. We added 10 more achievements and fixed the issue with the stamina. The player will now start with full stamina on each level. Any issues fell free to contact us. Thanks and hope to have some more updates for you sometime soon.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: We will be working on an update this week, so let us know if you run into any bugs! We will also be adding more achievements throughout the updates that we will have in the future. I know some people enjoy steam trading cards and we are in the process of making those for our game as well! So I hope enjoy our game and feel free to contact us!!
